summary_zh:
前往上方的「懸掛瀑布」就會經過的小瀑布，大概自停車場，走上來約 15 分鐘就可以抵達。

這個瀑布本身沒特別的好看，主要是前往前方的「懸掛瀑布」時你會經過，所以不需要為這個瀑布花太多時間停留。

會說建議停留時間 120 分鐘，是假設你會前往更裡面的懸掛瀑布，如果你有去，就要保留 120 分鐘在這兩個瀑布。
summary_en: The small waterfall can be reached after about a 15‑minute walk from the parking lot. It isn’t particularly striking on its own, but you’ll pass it on the way to the larger “Hanging Waterfall” ahead, so you don’t need to spend much time here. The suggested 120‑minute stay assumes you’ll also visit the Hanging Waterfall; if you do, allocate the full two hours for both sites.
